title: Do You Have That In Stock
section_path: Do You Have That In Stock
section_path_text: Do You Have That In Stock
summary:
After record crude inventories, product stocks are building
Over the last 12 to 15 months, there have been numerous reports of increasing crude oil stocks as oil supply exceeded oil demand by an estimated 1 to 2 million barrels per day (Mb/d). With healthy refining margins in most areas of the world, refineries continue to convert crude oil into refined products at a record pace. However, it appears that demand growth is levelling off and, as a result, product stocks have started to increase as well.
